title: Exploring thermal order in conformal theories with multiple scalars coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field
summary: We study thermal order in conformal field theories (CFTs) in $d=4-ε$ and $d=3$ dimensions where several scalars are coupled to an $O(N)$ vector field. In $(4-ε)$ dimensions, we consider models coupling a cubic model of $M$ scalars with $\mathbb{Z}_2^M\rtimes S_M$ symmetry (corresponding to sign flips and permutations of the scalars) to an $O(N)$ vector model. For any $M$, we find a window of $N$ in which two Wilson-Fisher-like fixed points exist.
